optionReasons.saa-ini-185:option:0: The Budgets alert when limits are reached — is not a visual analysis tool and detailed historical forecast.
optionReasons.saa-ini-185:option:1: The Trusted Advisor recommends good practice — does not plan expenditure over time.
optionReasons.saa-ini-185:option:2: The billing console shows the invoices — without interactive analysis comparing periods and generating forecasts.

finalJustifications: Because Cost Explorer visualizes historical expenditures with filters by service, account and tag, compares periods and generates cost forecasts based on history.
Because Cost Explorer audits who created each account resource, linking the expenses to the users responsible for creating.
Because Cost Explorer prevents the creation of resources above the budget, applying the financial ceiling defined by the company.
Because Cost Explorer is automatically enabled in accounts with expenditure above US$ 1.000 monthly, as a requirement of governance.

optionReasons.saa-ini-186:option:1: The Organizations group accounts and implement policies — does not set percentage alerts of budget per email.
optionReasons.saa-ini-186:option:2: Billing alarms from CloudWatch monitor total estimated expenditure, but do not offer alerts by budget percentage or expenditure PREVISTO as the Budgets.
optionReasons.saa-ini-186:option:3: The Cost Explorer analyses and predicts costs — does not send threshold alerts.

finalJustifications: Because Budgets accepts multiple alerts per budget (ex.: 80% and 100%), based on actual or projected expenditure, with notification by e-mail or SNS.
Because Budgets automatically suspends services when the limit bursts, protecting the startup from any extra charge.
Because Budgets is the only service that sees real-time billing, second by second, necessary basis for alerts.
Because Budgets discount 20% of the invoice when the alerts are configured, the incentive of AWS the governance of costs.

optionReasons.saa-ini-190:option:0: The Macie find sensitive data in S3 — does not identify idle resources.
optionReasons.saa-ini-190:option:1: Logs Insights consults application logs — orphaned volumes and Elastic IPs released do not appear in logs.
optionReasons.saa-ini-190:option:2: The Shield mitigates DDoS attacks — nothing to do with cost optimization.

finalJustifications: Because Trusted Advisor, in the cost optimization category, identifies volumes EBS not attached and Elastic IPs not associated, recommending removal.
Because Trusted Advisor deletes orphan volumes automatically after 7 days, returning the space to the account without intervention.
Because Trusted Advisor returns as credit the value spent with idle resources identified in the monthly checks.
Because Trusted Advisor migrating idle volumes to the S3 Glacier, reducing the cost until someone decides to remove them.

optionReasons.saa-ini-193:option:0: The IR reduces the price, but you keep paying 24/7 by a server that gets idle most of the time.
optionReasons.saa-ini-193:option:1: A larger instance AUMENTA the cost — the problem is idleness, not processing speed.
optionReasons.saa-ini-193:option:2: With a minimum of 1 instance, the server is always on — idle cost remains.

finalJustifications: Because Lambda charge by invocation and by milliseconds of execution — zero cost of computing in long periods without requests.
Because Lambda performs the function in an instance EC2 dedicated whose fixed cost is absorbed by AWS in serverless model.
Because Lambda is free for loads of few hundreds of daily requests, regardless of the duration of the execution.
Because Lambda keeps the status of the application between requests, exempting the bank and associated storage cost.

optionReasons.saa-ini-195:option:0: Read Replicas Scale LEITURA and add cost — do not generate discount in the main instance.
optionReasons.saa-ini-195:option:1: Performance Insights is a performance diagnostic tool — no precision option.
optionReasons.saa-ini-195:option:3: Multi-AZ increases the DISPONIBILIDADE (and cost, by doubling the infrastructure) — does not reduce the price.

finalJustifications: Because the RDS Reserved Instances give significant discount on On-Demand in exchange for the commitment of 1 or 3 years for a specific instance configuration.
Because the RIs of RDS include unlimited backups and free extended retention throughout the contract period.
Because the RIs of RDS eliminate the storage charge and IOPS, remaining only the cost of computing with discount.
Because the RIs of RDS convert the bank to serverless mode, which adjusts the capacity and cost automatically to use.

optionReasons.saa-ini-196:option:0: A monthly report comes too late and just shows the history — does not automatically detect anomalies.
optionReasons.saa-ini-196:option:2: The Budgets depends on a limit FIXO — doesn't learn patterns or catch anomalies that fall under the roof.
optionReasons.saa-ini-196:option:3: The Anomaly Detection of CloudWatch acts on operational metrics (CPU, latency) — not on account bill.

finalJustifications: Because Cost Anomaly Detection uses machine learning to learn the normal pattern of spending and alerting anomalous deviations even without any fixed bounds blown up.
Because it freezes the anonymous expense until a manual approval from the administrator, blocking the service that escaped the pattern.
Because it only works on accounts managed by AWS Organizations, where ML learns from the consolidated organization.
Because he predicts the month's bill with precision of cents using ML, eliminating the need for fixed limit alerts.

optionReasons.saa-ini-197:option:0: Reduce timeout does not change the price per millisecond executed — only limits long executions.
optionReasons.saa-ini-197:option:1: More memory AUMENTA the price per millisecond — only compensates if the duration is greatly reduced, which has not been requested.
optionReasons.saa-ini-197:option:2: Lambda Layers organise shared dependencies — do not change the function rate.

finalJustifications: Because the arm64 architecture (Graviton2) has a price for GB-second lower than x86_64 for the same memory, in compatible functions, without changing the logic.
Because arm64 folds the available memory of the function at no extra cost, reducing the effective price by GB-second configured.
Because arm64 functions do not pay for invocation, only for duration — Graviton's exclusive collection model2.
Because Graviton2 replicates the function in two regions for the price of one, doubling the throughput without doubling the invoice.

optionReasons.saa-ini-207:option:1: Tags are separation only LOGIC and fragile — a policy error IAM and the production resources are exposed to the environment of.
optionReasons.saa-ini-207:option:2: Object Lock protects objects S3 against exclusion — does not isolate whole work environments.
optionReasons.saa-ini-207:option:3: Separate VPCs isolate a REDE, but IAM, service limits and billing continue to be shared in the same account — blast radius remains.

finalJustifications: Because separate accounts are the strongest isolation frontier of the AWS: IAM, independent billing and limits, with contained blast radius — centrally managed via Organizations.
Because separate accounts automatically share roles IAM among themselves, simplifying the access of the teams to the three isolated environments of the company.
Because the AWS requires an environment account to release Business support plan, formal requirement of corporate environments in production.
Because separate accounts eliminate the costs of data transfer between environments, which would be charged in the same account per area of availability.
